description: Read one item or one provision of UK legislation from legislation.gov.uk — as it stands now (revised), as enacted/made, or as it stood on a date — in Markdown, with its editorial status, annotations (the applied amendment history), the unapplied effects touching it, the versions available, and attribution. Provision-level reads are the main path; an item-level read returns the whole text only for small items and otherwise an outline of provision paths to read next. With match_text (item level), returns the provisions whose text matches. Revised text is an editorial consolidation that can lag: read editorial.caveat and unapplied_effects before relying on it, and use uklaw_get_amendments for every recorded effect on an item, applied or not.

item.description: Item path {type}/{year}/{number} — ukpga/2018/12, uksi/2019/419, eur/2016/679, ukpga/Eliz2/3-4/19 — or any legislation.gov.uk URI (a URI carrying a provision, version, or /welsh is split into those parts; a version or /welsh in the URI applies unless the version or language input is set). Get it from uklaw_lookup_citation or uklaw_search_legislation.

language.description: en, or cy for the Welsh text of Welsh legislation (asc, anaw, mwa, wsi). Omitted: cy when an item URI ends in /welsh, else en. English is returned, with a notice, when no Welsh text exists.

match_text.description: Item level only (omit provision): return the outline of provisions whose text contains this term, e.g. "processor" — 100 entries per call; outline_offset reaches the rest.

outline_offset.description: Where a returned outline starts: 0 lists entries 1–100, 100 the next 100. Applies only when kind is outline (ignored when text is returned); a notice names the next offset while entries remain.

provision.description: Provision path — section/45/2/f, regulation/5, article/28/3, schedule/2/paragraph/3, part/3/chapter/2, introduction — or citation shorthand (s. 45(2)(f), reg. 5, art. 28(3), Sch. 2 para. 3), normalized before the request. Omit to read the item; an item-level outline lists the paths.

version.description: current (the latest revised text, or the original text for an item never revised), enacted (made, adopted and created are synonyms — the original text), or a date YYYY-MM-DD for the text as it stood then. Omitted: the version in an item URI, else current. A future date returns the latest version, and a date on or after the made or enactment date of an item never revised returns its original text, with a notice; version.applied reports the version served.

name: uklaw_get_document

annotations.description: Annotations referenced by the text, present when kind is full — the applied amendment history of the version served. When the text is cut, only those the kept text references.

citations.description: Legislation the annotation cites; empty when none.

title.description: Title of the cited item or provision, when given.

label.description: Label as it appears in the text, e.g. F1, I1.

type.description: Annotation type letter: F, C, I, M, E, P, or X (uklaw_list_reference topic annotation_types).

type_label.description: What the type records, e.g. Textual amendment.

attribution.description: Attribution lines the returned content requires (OGL always; EU and Westlaw credits when applicable).

editorial.description: Editorial status — read before relying on revised text.

caveat.description: How far to rely on this text, given its status.

document_status.description: final (as enacted/made), revised, or draft as legislation.gov.uk reports it; unknown when it reports none.

modified.description: When legislation.gov.uk last modified the document; absent when not reported.

outstanding_effects.description: Effects requiring a text change not yet applied that touch this provision, or at item level every such effect on the item: the full count, beyond the 20 unapplied_effects lists.

publisher.description: Publishers of the document as legislation.gov.uk reports them; empty when none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_item`: item is not a full {type}/{year}/{number} item path or legislation.gov.uk URI, its type code is unknown, or a URI carries an unreadable provision. `invalid_provision`: provision cannot be normalized, or conflicts with a provision embedded in item. `invalid_version`: version is shaped YYYY-MM-DD but is not a real calendar date, or a URI carried an unsupported version. `match_text_needs_item_level`: match_text is combined with provision. `document_not_found`: legislation.gov.uk has no such item, or the identifier check that would tell a missing item from a missing provision could not run in time. `provision_not_found`: The item exists but has no document at that provision path and version. `version_not_found`: Item level: the item exists but has no version at the requested date (the date precedes it). `upstream_refused`: legislation.gov.uk answered 403 or 429 (its fair use rate limit or a block). `pacer_shed`: The shared request queue cannot start this call within its deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

category.description: Category legislation.gov.uk reports: primary, secondary, or euretained; absent when not reported.

extent.description: Territorial extent of the whole item at the version served, e.g. E+W+S+N.I.; absent when not recorded (enacted and made text records none).

number.description: Number within the year (an ISBN for drafts); absent when not known.

type_label.description: Human label of the type code.

year.description: Calendar year; absent when the metadata reports none.

kind.description: full: text returned; outline: a list of provisions to read instead; pdf_only: the item is held as PDF only (see links.pdf).

akn.description: Akoma Ntoso XML, when legislation.gov.uk offers it.

pdf.description: Original PDF, when held (linked, never fetched by this server).

web.description: legislation.gov.uk page for the version read.

xml.description: CLML XML of the version read.

notice.description: Notices: Welsh fallback, original text served for a dated read, an omitted provision window, the unapplied effects an item outline leaves out, truncated lists, an outline window with the outline_offset that continues it, an oversized provision with no smaller child provisions returned whole or cut (its full size, and the links to the full text), and how to continue.

outline.description: Provisions to read next, present when kind is outline: up to 100 entries from outline_offset; empty when outline_offset is past the end.

chars.description: Rendered size in characters, counting the text and its annotations with their citations; present in outlines of an oversized provision, absent at item level.

heading.description: Heading, when the provision has one.

matches_text.description: True when the provision matched match_text.

provision.description: Provision path to pass back as provision.

status.description: Status legislation.gov.uk marks on the provision, e.g. Repealed; absent when unmarked.

outline_notice.description: How to read a provision from the outline, naming one to start with; past the outline’s end, its entry count.

provision.description: The provision read — present for provision-level reads.

extent.description: Territorial extent, e.g. E+W+S+N.I.; absent when not recorded.

heading.description: Heading of the provision, when it has one.

status.description: Status legislation.gov.uk marks on the provision, e.g. Repealed or Prospective; absent when unmarked.

valid_from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of this provision's own text window; it can differ from version.applied, which dates the whole document version. Both window ends come from one element, the nearest carrying either. Absent when that element records no start (enacted and made text records none), or when its window ends before it starts (a notice says so).

valid_to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) of this provision's own text window, when a later text of the provision supersedes it, from the same element as valid_from; absent while revised text is current, on enacted or made text, which records no window, and when the window ends before it starts (a notice says so).

text.description: The text as Markdown, present when kind is full; amendments are wrapped as [F1 …] keyed to annotations. A provision with no smaller child provisions that renders over 40,000 characters, counting its annotations, is cut to 40,000, and a notice gives its full size and the links to the full text.

unapplied_effects.description: Recorded effects not yet applied to the revised text that touch this provision (at item level, the item’s): the first 20, outstanding first, with a notice when more exist; empty when none. Absent on an item-level outline, where a notice gives the item’s count and uklaw_get_amendments lists them.

items.description: One effect: an amendment, repeal, commencement or modification.

affected.description: The affected legislation and the provisions the effect names on that side.

id_uri.description: Identifier URI of the affected legislation.

item.description: Item path of the affected legislation, e.g. ukpga/2018/12; absent when legislation.gov.uk gives no item URI.

provisions.description: Provisions of the affected legislation, each with its URI; empty for an effect on the whole item.

items.description: One provision or provision range named by the effect.

label.description: Provision as legislation.gov.uk labels it, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)".

missing.description: True when legislation.gov.uk marks the cited provision (or either end of a range) as missing from its data; absent otherwise.

up_to.description: Identifier URI of the last provision of a range such as "s. 65(2)-(4)"; absent for a single provision.

uri.description: Identifier URI of the provision, or of the first provision of a range; absent when legislation.gov.uk records none.

provisions_label.description: Provisions of the affected legislation as one label, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)" or "Sch. 2 para. 3".

affecting.description: The affecting legislation and the provisions the effect names on that side.

id_uri.description: Identifier URI of the affecting legislation.

item.description: Item path of the affecting legislation, e.g. ukpga/2018/12; absent when legislation.gov.uk gives no item URI.

provisions.description: Provisions of the affecting legislation, each with its URI; empty for an effect on the whole item.

items.description: One provision or provision range named by the effect.

label.description: Provision as legislation.gov.uk labels it, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)".

missing.description: True when legislation.gov.uk marks the cited provision (or either end of a range) as missing from its data; absent otherwise.

up_to.description: Identifier URI of the last provision of a range such as "s. 65(2)-(4)"; absent for a single provision.

uri.description: Identifier URI of the provision, or of the first provision of a range; absent when legislation.gov.uk records none.

provisions_label.description: Provisions of the affecting legislation as one label, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)" or "Sch. 2 para. 3".

applied.description: Whether editors have applied the effect to the revised text; absent when legislation.gov.uk does not report it.

commencement_authority.description: Provisions that commence the effect; empty when none are recorded.

items.description: One provision or provision range named by the effect.

label.description: Provision as legislation.gov.uk labels it, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)".

missing.description: True when legislation.gov.uk marks the cited provision (or either end of a range) as missing from its data; absent otherwise.

up_to.description: Identifier URI of the last provision of a range such as "s. 65(2)-(4)"; absent for a single provision.

uri.description: Identifier URI of the provision, or of the first provision of a range; absent when legislation.gov.uk records none.

extent.description: Extent of the affecting provision, e.g. "E+W", or "same as affected"; absent when not recorded.

in_force.description: Commencement entries for the effect; empty when none are recorded.

applied.description: Whether this commencement has been applied to the revised text.

commencing_uri.description: URI of the commencing provision, when recorded.

date.description: In-force date (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when not yet set.

prospective.description: True when the effect has no commencement date yet.

qualification.description: Qualification, e.g. "wholly in force", "for specified purposes".

modified.description: When legislation.gov.uk last modified the effect record, when reported.

notes.description: Reader-facing note, usually why the effect is not applied; absent when none.

outstanding.description: True when the effect requires a text change not reported as applied; an unreported applied or requires_applied counts toward true.

requires_applied.description: False when the effect needs no text change (conditional, superseded, text not held); absent when not reported.

savings.description: Savings provisions attached to the effect; empty when none are recorded.

items.description: One provision or provision range named by the effect.

label.description: Provision as legislation.gov.uk labels it, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)".

missing.description: True when legislation.gov.uk marks the cited provision (or either end of a range) as missing from its data; absent otherwise.

up_to.description: Identifier URI of the last provision of a range such as "s. 65(2)-(4)"; absent for a single provision.

uri.description: Identifier URI of the provision, or of the first provision of a range; absent when legislation.gov.uk records none.

type.description: Effect type as legislation.gov.uk records it (free text), e.g. "words substituted", "repealed".

welsh_applied.description: Dual-language items: whether the Welsh text has the change.

welsh_requires_applied.description: Dual-language items: whether the Welsh text needs the change.

applied.description: Version served: its start date (YYYY-MM-DD), the enacted keyword, or current when no date is reported.

available.description: Versions legislation.gov.uk lists for the document plus the one served — keywords such as enacted and point-in-time dates, each usable as version.

valid_to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the item version served — when a later version of the item takes over; absent for the latest version, and on enacted or made text, which records no window.

title: Read UK legislation text
